system.name: BACDL
system.one_liner: An incomplete multi-view clustering algorithm that bifurcates feature clusters into shared and specific determinants, couples views by distribution learning and has linear overhead.

content.variant_note: four titled dashed stage frames in a row, crossed by three colour-coded view lanes that turn grey where the views are fused
content.argues: Per-view feature clusters are split into shared and specific determinants, alienated by mutual exclusion, tied through one association D to sample clusters, then reordered and weighted into one common clustering embedding.
content.subject: Three incomplete views flowing through feature clusters, an association block, per-view sample clusters and adaptive weighting into a common embedding and results.

elements.name: View 1 Data, View r Data, View v Data
elements.role: the incomplete data of each view; dashed empty bars stand for missing samples
elements.drawn_as: three frames with a 1.25 pt outline in the view colour (green, pink, purple), each holding vertical coloured bars and dashed empty bars, vertical ellipses between them

elements.name: VG (P_1, P_r, P_v)
elements.role: view guidance that is coupled into the feature clusters by distribution learning
elements.drawn_as: rounded squares tinted in the view colour, each holding a circle with P and a subscript; label VG below

elements.name: C (PDD)
elements.role: the perspective-shared determinant, fed by all views
elements.drawn_as: grey circle labelled C with the caption PDD, inside the blue dashed sub-frame

elements.name: C_1, C_r, C_v (PCD)
elements.role: the perspective-specific determinants, one per view
elements.drawn_as: octagons in the three view colours with the caption PCD, inside the orange dashed sub-frame

elements.name: ME
elements.role: mutual exclusion learning that alienates shared and specific determinants to enlarge their discrimination
elements.drawn_as: a blue block arrow pointing left and an orange block arrow pointing right, label ME below, at the top and bottom of the frame

elements.name: Feature Clusters
elements.role: first stage: feature clusters bifurcated into shared (blue dashed sub-frame) and specific (orange dashed sub-frame) determinants
elements.drawn_as: black dashed rounded frame with a bold italic grey title at the bottom

elements.name: D (Association)
elements.role: the association between feature clusters and sample clusters that bridges all views
elements.drawn_as: grey-blue rounded square holding a darker circle labelled D, inside a dashed frame titled Association

elements.name: IV1SC, IVRSC, IVVSC
elements.role: sample clusters of incomplete view 1, r and v
elements.drawn_as: grids with coloured rows alternating with white rows (green, pink, purple), caption under each

elements.name: Space 1, Space r, Space v
elements.role: latent subspaces in which the sample clusters are reordered
elements.drawn_as: navy-framed boxes with small 3D axes and a faint curved arrow in the view colour

elements.name: AW
elements.role: adaptive weighting of the reordered sample clusters
elements.drawn_as: grey-blue rounded square holding a darker circle labelled AW

elements.name: CSC
elements.role: common sample clusters, the single mapped result
elements.drawn_as: grey grid with a bold caption

elements.name: Embedding
elements.role: the clustering embedding built from the common sample clusters
elements.drawn_as: tilted pale plane with 3D axes and a few green, pink and purple squares, soft shadow, bold caption

elements.name: Results
elements.drawn_as: dashed frame holding four navy-outlined rounded cards, each with a few green, pink and purple squares

new_tags.name: colour-lanes-merge-to-grey
new_tags.what: each view keeps one colour as a lane through every stage and the colour gives way to grey where the lanes are fused

lessons.what_to_learn: Give each view a colour that runs as a lane through every stage and turns grey where the views are fused; frame the stages with dashed rectangles titled at the bottom, and draw incomplete data as bars with dashed gaps.
lessons.suits: Multi-view, multi-modal or multi-client pipelines where parallel streams of the same kind are processed separately and then fused.

evidence: It firstly bifurcates feature clusters on each incomplete view and magnifies the discrimination between determinants via mutual exclusion learning.
all sample clusters are reordered in latent subspace and, following adaptive weighting, mapped to a common one

summary: BACDL is an incomplete multi-view clustering algorithm that bifurcates the feature clusters of each view into perspective-shared and perspective-specific determinants, alienates them by mutual exclusion, couples view guidance into the clusters by distribution learning, and bridges the views through an association between feature and sample clusters, at linear cost. Figure 1 draws the pipeline as four dashed stage frames (Feature Clusters, Association, Sample Clusters, Results) crossed by three colour-coded view lanes: green View 1, pink View r and purple View v, each starting as a bar matrix with dashed missing bars. The lanes turn grey where they are fused: the shared determinant C, the association block D, the adaptive-weighting block AW and the common table CSC, which leads to an embedding and four result cards.
summary_zh: BACDL是不完整多视图聚类算法：把特征簇分为视角共享与特有的决定因素，用互斥学习拉开差异，经关联块D连接各视图，线性开销。图1用四个虚线阶段框和绿、粉、紫三条视图色带表示，色带在C、D、AW、CSC处融合为灰色。
notes: The four dashed stage frames are treated as stage containers of one pipeline (panel_count 1, with three view lanes) rather than as panels. The roles of the ME arrow pair and of the lines from the VG nodes to C are read from the caption and the drawn arrows. The index lists 7 small bitmaps (axis glyphs, embedding plane, block arrows).
